name: The Dundrum Inn
improvements: The booking fields hand to dundruminn.com rather than deep-linking the dates into GuestDiary. Verify GuestDiary's parameter format against the live engine and the handoff can carry the dates through, as Enniskeen does with Bookin1.

Re-check whether the Inn's booking card already sits on the first screen. The 24 July before capture shows a Book your stay card with check-in, check-out, adults, children and promo code across the lower right of the opening video, which does not sit easily with the case-study note that the gap is how far you travel down the page before reaching the booking. Confirm against the live site at phone and desktop width and correct the note, or drop it, before the concept is used for outreach.
summary: Rebuilt and elevated on 1 August 2026. The 24 July concept passed triage but lost to the Inn's own live website, and the review that followed was blunt about why: it carried no photograph of a business whose product is a view and a garden, replaced the Inn's blush-and-cream identity and 1834 crest with black, brass and Bodoni, set body copy in Space Mono, rendered its whole four-item navigation struck through as dead placeholder links, and printed a pitch note about the client's current site inside the client's proposed site. The new pass keeps the sourced strategy and adds the missing lived sequence: day and blue-hour faithful exterior frames, one Today at the Inn front door, bay-to-bar-to-bed route, named stay keys, a code-drawn indicative place plate, and a focused responsive journey check. The live booking destination remains the source of truth.
verificationNote: Re-checked 26 July 2026. Winter 2026 bar hours recorded verbatim for all seven days; the Inn publishes no kitchen or food-service time and no room prices, so both the kitchen closing time and the nightly price used by the first concept were inventions and have been removed. Four named rooms plus Murlough Cottage confirmed. The 2 August Fleadh Cheoil listing confirmed. Irish already exists at /?lang=ga inside a 28+ language machine-translation widget.
sampleDataNote: There is no illustrative sample data on the rebuilt page. The open-or-closed state is computed in the browser from the published bar hours in Europe/London; the event comes from the Inn's events listing; the rooms cell is a search rather than a count. The hero is a disclosed AI-generated faithful visualisation based on the Inn's own exterior photograph.
mediaNote: After still and clip recaptured 1 August 2026 from the elevated concept; the 24 July after-media showed the retired black-and-brass page. The before capture is unchanged. The after still now records the blue-hour first viewport and the clip records the updated journey sequence.
